candidates.content_angle: Explains the rules for carrying children on a motorbike under Law 36/2024/QH15: one passenger, or two when one of them is a child under 12 (Article 33(1)(c)); a fastened helmet that meets the national standard for the rider and every passenger (Article 33(2)); the passenger bans of Article 33(4) that also apply to children; the penalties in Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: VND 400,000 to 600,000 for carrying two people outside the exceptions (Article 7(2)(g)) and for carrying a passenger without a fastened motorcycle helmet, with an exception for children under six (Article 7(2)(i)), VND 600,000 to 800,000 and 2 licence points for carrying three or more people (Article 7(3)(b) and 7(13)(a)), VND 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 and licence suspension for steering from behind the person in front unless that person is a child under six sitting in front (Article 7(9)(h) and 7(12)(b)), and the passenger's own fine for riding without a helmet (Article 12(5)(b)); and general advice on child-sized helmets, where a small child sits, holding on, keeping legs away from the exhaust, heat, rain and short stages.
candidates.working_title: 在越南骑摩托车带孩子：头盔、坐的位置和12岁以下儿童的规定
